title: Glass Hook v4 (A' double)
comment: Glass Hook grown into a looping demo in E minor, 90 BPM: Intro (Rhodes alone), A (the hook over the trap groove), B (Am9 Bm7 Cmaj7 D6 | Am9 Bm7 Cmaj7 B7, a calmer guitar melody with the same designed bends), A' (the hook doubled by a second guitar, with vibraphone above). Toy MIDI plays the notes without the bends.
